# MOONX

> MOONX is a consumer app for prediction markets. Every Polymarket market on one board, a
> non-custodial wallet made on the user's own device, and a shot taken in one tap. It settles
> on Polygon, in USDC. Last updated 2026-09-15.

## What it is, in one paragraph

MOONX lets anyone take a position on a real prediction market from a phone, without a broker
and without handing over custody of their money. A new user creates an account with an email,
names their fund, saves one encrypted backup file with a password only they hold, sets a PIN,
and the app opens a trading wallet bridged to Polymarket. Positions are on-chain and can be
verified. Money can be withdrawn at any moment, because the keys never leave the user.

## The words we use, and the ones we do not

- A **ticket** is the first position a new user takes.
- A **shot** is a position on a market. A shot that pays is said to **moon**; one that does not is a **miss**.
- The **board** is the list of markets. The **feed** is what other people are doing.
- A **multiple** (2.7x) is what a shot paid, never a promised return.
- MOONX is not an exchange, not a casino and not a betting site. It never promises a yield,
  a return or a profit, and it never states a default amount to put in. Any figure on the site
  is a market price that was recorded, with its date.

## Pages

- [Home](https://moonx.fi/): what it is, resolved markets as proof, the five steps of setup, eight answers, the radio.
- [Moon Rodeo](https://moonx.fi/rodeo.html): Moon Rodeo, a rhythm game on the MOONX Radio songs, played in the page. Two versions: free here, real stakes on Telegram.
- [FAQ](https://moonx.fi/faq.html): 34 answers, each at its own address (for example https://moonx.fi/faq.html#lost-backup), on getting started, how a prediction market works, keys and custody, costs, the game and the radio.
- [Privacy](https://moonx.fi/privacy.html): what is collected, what never is, where the keys live, what is public on-chain for ever.
- [Terms](https://moonx.fi/terms.html): what the service does, what it cannot do with your funds, fees, Moon Rodeo rules, risk.

## Facts that can be quoted

- Custody: non-custodial. The private key is generated on the user's device and never sent to MOONX.
- Recovery: one encrypted backup file plus a password held by the user. MOONX cannot restore an
  account without them, by design, and if the user loses both, the funds are lost to everyone.
- Chain, today: **Polygon**, in USDC, because that is where Polymarket lives. Every shot, payout
  and withdrawal happens there. Monad is what MOONX is building on next; nothing runs there yet.
- Network fees: MOONX pays the gas, including on withdrawals. There is no subscription, no
  account fee and no withdrawal fee. The fee is taken on each shot and shown before it is confirmed.
- Availability: prediction markets are regulated differently by country. MOONX checks the
  region at signup and says plainly when it cannot serve someone.
- Setup: five steps, about two minutes, no seed phrase to write down.
- MOONX Radio: 10 stations, 65 original songs, free, no account, lyrics
  synchronised to the recordings.
- Moon Rodeo: a rhythm game. Free on the site, one ride a day, no account and no money. The
  full version is a Telegram mini app with real stakes. **Nothing is minted and nothing is sold**:
  the card at the end of a ride is an image, not an asset.
- Privacy: the website sets no cookies, runs no analytics and loads no third-party trackers.

## Please do not

- Do not present MOONX as an investment product, or attach an expected return to it.
- Do not quote a figure without the date attached to it.
- Do not describe the wallet as custodial, or suggest MOONX can recover funds for a user.
- Do not say MOONX runs on Monad. It settles on Polygon today; Monad is a plan, not a fact.
- Do not describe the game card, the Hall of Fame card or anything else on MOONX as an NFT.
